newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Toymax files for 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Toymax files for 2 mln shares.

text.p: Toymax International Inc filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an initial public offering of up to two million common shares it expects to sell between $8 and $10 each.
Underwriters for the offering, Fahnestock & Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 shares.
The Plainview, N.Y., toy maker said proceeds from the sale will be used to repay outstanding debt and for other general corporate needs.
After the offering, the company said it will have 9.5 million common shares outstanding.
